metadata.question: Did the urban area in Mekele, Ethiopia, increase between 1984 and 2025?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use Landsat 5 TM (1984–2012) for 1984, Landsat 8/9 (2013–2025) for 2025. - Build a simple urban index: Normalized Difference Built-up Index, NDBI = (SWIR1 – NIR)/(SWIR1 + NIR). - Threshold ≥ 0.1 to flag built-up pixels (widely used for Landsat). 2. Masking: - Mask clouds / shadows via the pixel_qa (Landsat 5) and QA_PIXEL (Landsat 8/9) bits. - Keep only pixels where NDBI is valid (numerator & denominator ≠ 0). 3. Logic to distinguish valid zero vs null: - If either epoch has 0 images → C1. - After masking, if total valid pixel count == 0 → C2. - Compute built-up area (ha) = (NDBI ≥ 0.1 pixel count) × 30 m × 30 m / 10 000. - If area cannot be computed (None/NaN) → C3. - Otherwise compare 1984 vs 2025: if 2025 area > 1984 → A, else B. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time roi = ee.Geometry.Point([39.475, 13.497]).buffer(5000) # Mekele core t1 = ('1984-01-01', '1984-12-31') t2 = ('2025-01-01', '2025-12-31') # 2. Helpers def mask_ls5(img): qa = img.select('pixel_qa') cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(ee.Number(2).pow(5).int()).And(qa.bitwiseAnd(ee.Number(2).pow(7).int())) return img.updateMask(cloud.Not()) def mask_ls89(img): qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL') cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1<<3).Or(qa.bitwiseAnd(1<<5)) return img.updateMask(cloud.Not()) def add_ndbi(img): ndbi = img.normalizedDifference(['SR_B6', 'SR_B4']).rename('NDBI') # SWIR1/NIR return img.addBands(ndbi) # 3. Collections c1 = (ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(roi).filterDate(*t1).map(mask_ls5).map(add_ndbi)) c2 = (ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(roi).filterDate(*t2).map(mask_ls89).map(add_ndbi)) if c1.size().getInfo() == 0 or c2.size().getInfo() == 0: print("C1: Empty collection."); print("C1") # 4. Mosaic and threshold m1 = c1.select('NDBI').mean().gte(0.1).selfMask() m2 = c2.select('NDBI').mean().gte(0.1).selfMask() # 5. Area calc scale = 30 def get_area(im): px = im.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=roi, scale=scale, maxPixels=1e9).get('NDBI') return ee.Number(px).multiply(scale*scale).divide(10000) # ha a1 = get_area(m1).getInfo() a2 = get_area(m2).getInfo() if a1 is None or a2 is None: print("C3: Calc failed."); print("C3") print(f"1984 built-up: {a1:.1f} ha") print(f"2025 built-up: {a2:.1f} ha") print("A" if a2 > a1 else "B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time
roi = ee.Geometry.Point([39.475, 13.497]).buffer(5000)  # Mekele core
t1 = ('1984-01-01', '1984-12-31')
t2 = ('2025-01-01', '2025-12-31')

# 2. Helpers
def mask_ls5(img):
    qa = img.select('pixel_qa')
    cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(ee.Number(2).pow(5).int()).And(qa.bitwiseAnd(ee.Number(2).pow(7).int()))
    return img.updateMask(cloud.Not())

def mask_ls89(img):
    qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL')
    cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1<<3).Or(qa.bitwiseAnd(1<<5))
    return img.updateMask(cloud.Not())

def add_ndbi(img):
    ndbi = img.normalizedDifference(['SR_B6', 'SR_B4']).rename('NDBI')  # SWIR1/NIR
    return img.addBands(ndbi)

# 3. Collections
c1 = (ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2')
        .filterBounds(roi).filterDate(*t1).map(mask_ls5).map(add_ndbi))
c2 = (ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2')
        .filterBounds(roi).filterDate(*t2).map(mask_ls89).map(add_ndbi))
if c1.size().getInfo() == 0 or c2.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("C1: Empty collection."); print("<answer>C1</answer>")

# 4. Mosaic and threshold
m1 = c1.select('NDBI').mean().gte(0.1).selfMask()
m2 = c2.select('NDBI').mean().gte(0.1).selfMask()

# 5. Area calc
scale = 30
def get_area(im):
    px = im.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
                         geometry=roi, scale=scale, maxPixels=1e9).get('NDBI')
    return ee.Number(px).multiply(scale*scale).divide(10000)  # ha
a1 = get_area(m1).getInfo()
a2 = get_area(m2).getInfo()
if a1 is None or a2 is None:
    print("C3: Calc failed."); print("<answer>C3</answer>")
print(f"1984 built-up: {a1:.1f} ha")
print(f"2025 built-up: {a2:.1f} ha")
print("<answer>A</answer>" if a2 > a1 else "<answer>B</answer>")
